debug.title: The Vanishing Increments
debug.description: In each round two threads each add 1 to a shared counter, so after r rounds the counter should be 2r. The program prints a smaller number. Input: the number of rounds r. Output: 'Count: ' followed by the final counter.
hints: Run with 1 round. The count should be 2. Why would two increments produce only 1?
Look at increment(). Both threads can read count before either one writes it back.
The read-modify-write on the shared counter is not atomic, so one update overwrites the other (a lost update).
Make increment() synchronized (or guard the read and write with one lock) so only one thread at a time runs the whole read-sleep-write sequence.
